# Test fixtures

Fixtures must be:

- Synthetic and non-identifying
- Free of secrets, tokens, and real customer content
- Stable enough for deterministic tests

## Future AI evaluation fixtures

When AI evaluation fixtures are introduced, each fixture should document:

- Intent
- Skill level
- Input language
- Expected lifecycle mode

Use lowercase kebab-case filenames with intent, for example `new-build-beginner.json`.
